per_diem.question: What is the international per diem for meals and incidentals?
per_diem.text: The international per diem for meals and incidental expenses is 95 USD per day, as stated in [S1] POL-EXP-006 "International Travel and Per Diem" (v3.0, current, chars 3106-3810).

pre_approval.question: What is the pre-approval threshold for a single expense?
pre_approval.text: The pre-approval threshold for a single expense is 500 USD, as stated in [S1]. Recurring subscriptions of any value require pre-approval regardless of the individual charge amount, because the aggregate annual cost is the relevant figure [S1].

expense_deadline.question: How many days do I have to submit an expense claim?
expense_deadline.text: The expense claim should be submitted within 30 calendar days of the date the expense was incurred, as stated in the current version of the Expense Reimbursement Policy [S1]. If the claim is submitted after this window, it requires written justification from the employee's manager and is approved at the discretion of Finance Operations.

receipt_threshold.question: From what amount do I need an itemised receipt?
receipt_threshold.text: From the provided policies, an itemised receipt is required for expenses of 25 USD or more, as stated in [S1]. For expenses below 25 USD, a written description of the expense and its business purpose is sufficient.

pto_carryover.question: How many unused PTO days can I carry into the next year?
pto_carryover.text: Employees can carry a maximum of 5 unused PTO days into the next year, as stated in [S1]. Any unused days beyond the carryover limit are forfeited at year end and are not paid out, except where local law requires otherwise [S1].

sick_leave.question: How many paid sick days do employees receive per year?
sick_leave.text: Employees receive up to 10 paid sick days per calendar year, as stated in [S1].

parental_leave.question: How many weeks of paid parental leave are employees entitled to?
parental_leave.text: Employees are entitled to 16 weeks of paid parental leave following the birth or adoption of a child, available to all parents regardless of gender [S1].

core_hours.question: What are the core collaboration hours for remote employees?
core_hours.text: The core collaboration hours for remote employees are between 10:00 and 16:00 in the time zone of their assigned office [S1]. Meetings requiring cross-team attendance are scheduled exclusively within this window. Employees working outside their assigned office time zone by more than three hours must agree a written overlap schedule with their manager [S1].

stipend.question: What is the one-time home office stipend for remote employees?
stipend.text: The one-time home office stipend for remote employees is 800 USD within their first six months of remote status, as stated in [S1]. After that, a recurring annual allowance of 300 USD is provided for consumables and replacements [S1]. However, it's important to note that this stipend does not cover rent, utilities, or internet service [S1]. For more details on the submission deadlines, receipt requirements, and eligible items, please refer to POL-EXP-002 and POL-EXP-003 mentioned in [S1].

policy_code.question: POL-EXP-004
policy_code.text:
The expense policy (POL-EXP-004) governs the reimbursement of business expenses incurred by employees on behalf of the company. It applies to all employees worldwide, including those on hybrid and fully remote arrangements [S1]. Expenses must be reasonable, necessary, and directly connected to company business [S1].

Expense claims must be submitted within 30 calendar days of the date the expense was incurred [S2]. Claims older than 90 calendar days will not be reimbursed under any circumstances [S2]. Reimbursements are paid through the standard payroll cycle following approval, and employees should expect payment within two pay periods [S2].

Any single expense exceeding 1,000 USD requires written manager approval before the expense is incurred [S4]. Recurring subscriptions above 1,000 USD annually also require pre-approval [S4].

The following are never reimbursable: traffic fines and parking penalties, personal travel insurance, in-flight entertainment and internet upgrades, airport lounge memberships purchased individually, childcare, pet care, personal grooming, and losses arising from personal negligence [S5]. Expenses incurred while working from another country under a personal remote work arrangement are also non-reimbursable [S5].

tuition_refusal.question: What is the annual tuition reimbursement cap for employees?
tuition_refusal.text: The annual tuition reimbursement cap for employees is not specified in the provided policies. [S1], [S2], [S3], [S4], and [S5] do not contain information regarding tuition reimbursement caps.
